plants.title: Rose
plants.description: Fresh rose plant nurtured in our Bangalore botanical studio. Produces beautiful, fragrant blooms with proper sunlight and regular watering. Ideal for home gardens, balconies, and patios. Plant in well-draining soil enriched with organic compost. Provide 4–6 hours of sunlight daily and avoid overwatering to encourage healthy growth and vibrant flowering.
